runtimeImplementation.positionBalanceAcceptance: Every eligible item appears in early, middle and late segments; rotating items differ by at most one exposure and fixed anchors stay within one administration of the ideal per-segment count across 12 variants
runtimeImplementation.activationCondition: Freeze non-empty anchors and expanded eligible pools after G0 before field collection

rules: Use only items retained by G0
Cover every modeled construct needed for booklet linking
Keep anchor wording and scoring invariant across booklets and languages

preflightChecks: Every eligible item appears in at least one booklet
Every booklet has between 40 and 60 content items
All booklets contain the frozen anchor block
No matched quartet violates minimum separation
The item co-occurrence graph is connected
Expected exposure reaches the registered per-item target
Early, middle and late exposure imbalance is reported
Seed replay reproduces booklet, block and item order exactly
releaseRule: No booklet may collect responses until G0 passes and simulation-based power and coverage checks are frozen.
